summary_1line: Yudhishthira hesitates to challenge Jarasandha for the Rajasuya, while Bhima, Krishna, and Arjuna argue that strategy, strength, and valor can defeat him and free captive kings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna, Bhima, and Arjuna stand together before the anxious Yudhishthira, declaring that policy, strength, and victory united will bring down Jarasandha.
Dozens of captive kings sit chained inside a temple of Shiva, awaiting sacrifice under the cruel rule of Jarasandha.
Arjuna, armed with his great bow and inexhaustible quivers, speaks boldly in the royal hall about the supremacy of valor.
